features: 5MP (2592x1944 @ 30 fps) H.264/H.265 network box camera, CS/I-CS mount (lens not included), Auto Back Focus
True WDR, mechanical day/night, DC-Iris and P-Iris lens support
AdaptiveStream smart compression (iZone, iStream, dynamic 3DNR), triple H.265/H.264/MJPEG streams
onboard analytics: motion, tampering, intrusion, loitering, line counting, borderline, abandoned, departure, area counting, withdrawn, adverse way
audio in/out (G.711 a-law/u-law), 1x alarm in / 1x alarm out, micro SDHC/SDXC edge storage, integrated with Verint EdgeVR platform

frigate.notes: Verint ONVIF camera (EdgeVR platform) — RTSP path not published; use go2rtc ONVIF autodiscovery (onvif://{user}:{pass}@{ip}) to resolve the stream URL.

blue_iris.notes: Use Generic ONVIF/RTSP; discover the stream path.
